boundary: Six separately commissioned fresh model reviews using fictionalized analytical lenses. No named person participated; no human approval, rights verification, or release authorization.
inputs: Complete frozen rendered public text and link inventories for twelve routes, a public-safe source note, the redacted public claim/source registry, the assigned frozen rubric, and twelve current screenshots. No implementation discussion, prior reviews, protected source bodies, or raw third-party article.
receiptProjection: Raw reviewer receipts retained without rewriting scores, findings, gaps, or recommendations. Repo-relative public screenshot paths were requested before completion; no private packet locator is published.
limits: Reviewers did not independently inspect protected source bodies, original permissions, or all external publication content.
The twelve screenshots cover home and About methods; dedicated DCLA paragraph layout was tested separately, not by these holdouts.
Automated browser interaction evidence is separate from model reading and does not establish human usability or accessibility approval.
One reviewer noted an older source-note count description; the nonblocking observation remains in its receipt.
Composite and photo gates remain independent and held.
